name: Metaview
mood: Bioluminescent control room: a near-black green-tinted AI product surface lit by a single living mint signal.

deepForest.role: Page background, hero canvas, sections, and footer.

pineBark.role: Cards, product mockup containers, nested panels, and dark secondary buttons.

charcoal.role: Elevated card surface, modals, popovers, and overlaid containers.

abyssalIndigo.role: Borders, outlined action edges, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

paperWhite.role: Primary text, inverted button text, icons, and dark-theme reading copy.

ashGray.role: Muted body text, helper copy, and secondary descriptions.

silver.role: Light borders, dividers, and hairline rules on mid-tone surfaces.

pureBlack.role: Maximum contrast text, outline borders, and baseline dark value.

electricMint.role: Primary CTA, selected navigation, active tabs, and live status indicators.

mintWhisper.role: Pale selected-tab backgrounds, decorative borders, and subtle highlight washes.

fallbacks.primary: Inter, DM Sans, Space Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif
fallbacks.code: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace

rules: Use Euclid Circular A-style type for all main UI.
Use tight negative tracking on large sizes.
Use positive tracking on small labels.
Use Onsite SemiMono for counts, metrics, IDs, and technical micro-copy.

components.name: Pill Primary Button
components.recipe: Electric Mint fill, Deep Forest text, 999px radius, 8px by 16px padding, Euclid 14px/500.

components.name: Outlined Ghost Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px Paper White border, Paper White text, 999px radius, 8px by 16px padding, Euclid 14px/500.

components.name: Dark Secondary Button
components.recipe: Pine Bark fill, 1px Abyssal Indigo border, Paper White text, 16px radius, 8px by 16px padding.

components.name: Top Navigation Bar
components.recipe: Deep Forest background, 80px tall, wordmark left, nav center, sign-in and CTAs right, no shadow.

components.name: Hero Section
components.recipe: Deep Forest canvas, centered 1200px stack, 68px weight-300 headline, Ash Gray paragraph, mint CTA plus ghost CTA.

components.name: Product Showcase Card
components.recipe: Bioluminescent Bloom backdrop, Pine Bark card, 1px Abyssal Indigo border, 16px radius, 24px padding.

components.name: Side Icon Nav Rail
components.recipe: Vertical tab stack, Mint Whisper active item, Ash Gray inactive labels, 4px active radius.

components.name: Chat Interface Panel
components.recipe: Pine Bark panel, 8px input, Abyssal border, circular submit button, SemiMono counts.

components.name: Tab Pill Group
components.recipe: 100px pill tabs, Mint Whisper active background, Deep Forest active text, Paper White inactive text.

components.name: Filter Bar
components.recipe: 28px chips, 4px radius, Abyssal border, SemiMono counts.

components.name: Feature Card
components.recipe: Pine Bark card, Abyssal border, 16px radius, 24px padding, mint or white icon.

do: Use Electric Mint only for primary CTA, active tab, and live status indicators.
Set display headlines at weight 300 with tight negative tracking.
Use 999px radius for buttons and tab pills.
Use 16px radius for cards and 8px for inputs.
Use Bioluminescent Bloom only behind product mockup sections.
Render counts, metrics, IDs, and technical labels in Onsite SemiMono.
Pair each mint CTA with a ghost secondary button.
dont: Do not use 600 or 700 for display headlines.
Do not apply Electric Mint to large surfaces or body text.
Do not use drop shadows for card elevation.
Do not introduce new accent colors or gradients.
Do not use Ash Gray for headings above 16px.
Do not use non-pill buttons for main actions.
Do not use light card surfaces on the dark canvas.

imagery.style: Product screenshots and realistic product mockups over a green radial bloom.
rules: Use product UI as the primary visual element.
Use Bioluminescent Bloom only behind showcase sections.
Keep icons monoline, geometric, and utilitarian.

layout.structure: 1200px centered content with full-bleed atmospheric product sections.
layout.navigation: Announcement strip above an 80px Deep Forest nav.
layout.sectionRhythm: 80px section gaps with seamless dark-canvas flow.
